summary: One letter in a thread of mail: a head with the sender's picture, their name, their address while open, the time at the end with a paperclip before it when files came along, and under the name the recipients while open or the letter's first words while folded. The body follows under the head, lined up with the name from 640 up. The head is a button that folds and unfolds the letter, as a thread folds the letters already read; foldable false keeps a letter open (the thread's latest) with a head that is no button. A rule under each letter sets the letters of a thread apart.

anatomy.letter: An article, padded 16 across (24 from md) and 12 down and up, 20 under an open letter, with a 1px rule in border under it.
anatomy.head: The head: the picture, then a column of the name line and the line under it. While foldable, a button over the whole head, named by what it holds and saying whether it is expanded; otherwise plain.
anatomy.avatar: The sender's picture (parts of PersonAvatar at md): 32 round, their initials where no picture is given.
anatomy.name: The sender's name, cut short on one line.
anatomy.address: While open: the address it came from, 8 after the name, cut short; not drawn below 640.
anatomy.time: At the name line's end: the time it was sent, in tabular figures, with a 14 paperclip before it, named words.attached, when files came along.
anatomy.line: Under the name: while open, the recipients (words.to); while folded, the snippet, its first words. Cut short on one line.
anatomy.body: While open: the app's content (the letter's text, its files, its replies), 12 under the head, its pieces 16 apart, indented 44 from 640 up so it lines up with the name.

to.does: The recipients' names, read out under the sender while the letter is open (words.to).

time.does: When it was sent, at the head's end.

attached.does: Files came with it: a paperclip before the time.

snippet.does: The line under the sender while the letter is folded: its first words.

open.does: Whether the letter is open, when the app holds it (open with onOpenChange); left to itself it starts at defaultOpen.

defaultOpen.does: Whether a letter that holds itself starts open.

foldable.does: Whether a press on the head folds the letter; false keeps it open, its head no button.

children.does: The letter's body, its files and its replies, drawn while it is open.

letter.note: 24 across from md (768); 20 under an open letter.

head.note: The picture, then the name's column.

name.note: text.sm at weight 500, as its paint says.

nameLine.note: The name, the address and the time on one line, set on their baseline; the time pushed to the end.

padXFromMd.note: The letter's side padding from md (768) up.

openFoot.note: The padding under an open letter.

bodyTop.note: Between the head and the body.

bodyIndent.note: The body's start from 640 up: the picture's 32 and the head's 12, so it lines up with the name.

addressFrom.note: Below this width of the window the address is not drawn.

rest.means: Folded: the picture, the name, the time and the snippet under the name; no body.

open.means: Open: the address beside the name, the recipients under it, the body under the head, 20 under the letter.
open.reached: a press on the head, open, defaultOpen, or foldable false

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a foldable head: a focus-ring-width ring in ring around it, rounded radius-control, with no offset.

fixed.means: foldable false: the letter is open and its head is no button, reached by no key.

rest.note: In the ink of what it stands on.
Tabular figures; the paperclip in the same ink.

appText.from: The sender's name, address and picture.
appText.time: When it was sent, as the app writes it.
appText.to: The recipients' names, which words.to joins with a comma and a space.

sokkel-ui: The head is a native button with aria-expanded; the time is set with tabular-nums.
Its words are a private default object (WORDS) merged under words; to is a function of the names.
